collisiondamage.configuration.accelerati: How large the player's deceleration must be before they begin taking damage (measured in m/s).
collisiondamage.configuration.damageMult: Multiplies the damage taken over the threshold. Default 1.0x is 1 damage per 1 m/s over threshold.
collisiondamage.configuration.damageType: Use the FLY_INTO_WALL damage type. If false, uses FALL (so feather falling, etc. also affects collision damage).
Maximum damage per hit. Set to 0 for no cap.
collisiondamage.configuration.ignoreWhen: Skip collision damage while riding (boats, horses, etc.).
collisiondamage.configuration.ignoreInWa: Skip collision damage while in water.
collisiondamage.configuration.includeYAx: Include Y axis collision damage from upward impacts.
collisiondamage.configuration.damageVehi: Damage the vehicle when the rider triggers collision damage.
collisiondamage.configuration.globalColl: Apply collision damage to all living entities, not just players.
